title: E-Certificates
subtitle: Configure certificate design, signatories and remarks, then preview and download for active rostered players.

design.heading: Certificate design
design.help: Choose a preset style. All designs share the same details so switching never loses your settings.

CLASSIC.name: Classic
CLASSIC.desc: Double gold border, serif title. Formal, suits schools and associations.

MODERN.name: Modern
MODERN.desc: AthleticaOS navy and crimson band, left-aligned. Default brand look.

ORGANISER_COLOURS.name: Organiser colours
ORGANISER_COLOURS.desc: Corner bands in your organisation's primary and secondary colours.

PITCH.name: Pitch
PITCH.desc: Faint rugby pitch lines, green accent, bold condensed type.

PRINT_SAVER.name: Print-saver
PRINT_SAVER.desc: Black on white with thin lines. Lowest ink use for bulk office printing.

SONGKET_GOLD.name: Songket Gold
SONGKET_GOLD.desc: Navy border with a gold songket band and corner ornaments on cream. Formal and elegant.

HIBISCUS_ENERGY.name: Hibiscus Energy
HIBISCUS_ENERGY.desc: Crimson and coral ribbons with hibiscus petals in two corners. Bright and celebratory.

PITCH_DYNAMIC.name: Rugby Pitch Dynamic
PITCH_DYNAMIC.desc: Mown-pitch green stripes and try-line marks at the top and bottom. Sporty.

STADIUM_LIGHTS.name: Stadium Lights
STADIUM_LIGHTS.desc: Navy to electric-blue bands with floodlight rays and sparkles. Big-match feel.

BATIK_WAVE.name: Batik Wave
BATIK_WAVE.desc: Teal batik waves with yellow leaves down both sides. Fresh and Malaysian.

CHAMPIONS_RIBBON.name: Champions Ribbon
CHAMPIONS_RIBBON.desc: Purple and gold diagonal ribbons with confetti. Made for finals and awards.

settings.heading: Certificate details
settings.customTitlePlaceholder: Leave blank for default (Certificate of Participation / Sijil Penyertaan)
settings.remarkPlaceholder: e.g. Certified that the above took part in the tournament in the spirit of the game.
settings.showVerificationHint: Anyone scanning the QR code can verify authenticity on the public verification page.
settings.verificationUrlMissing: Public verification URL is not configured on this server; QR codes will be hidden on PDFs.
settings.signatureImage: Signature image (PNG or JPEG, max 500 KB)
settings.signatureTooLarge: Signature file must be 500 KB or smaller.
settings.signatureInvalidType: Please choose a PNG or JPEG image.

preview.heading: Live preview
preview.help: Preview one sample certificate in the selected design before issuing and downloading.
preview.unsavedHint: Save settings first to include edited remarks, titles or signatures in the preview.

roster.heading: Participants by category & team
roster.empty: No active teams or rostered players found for this tournament.
roster.revokeMessage: Revoking {{name}}'s certificate ({{code}}) will mark it as revoked on the public verification page and exclude it from future downloads. This cannot be undone.
roster.downloadBusy: Another certificate download is running, try again in a minute.
roster.downloadFailed: Certificate download failed. Please try again.

verify.pageDescription: Verify the authenticity of an AthleticaOS tournament e-certificate.
verify.validSubtitle: This participation certificate was officially issued through AthleticaOS.
verify.revokedSubtitle: This certificate has been revoked by the tournament organiser and is no longer valid.
verify.notFoundBody: We could not find a certificate with code "{{code}}", or verification has been turned off by the organiser.
